'''Darth Love Obeisance v 2.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Love]]
* '''Published:''' 15 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif|label=This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Deal Love DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits We're The Bait (V), Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V), Admiral Motti (V), A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V), Atmospheric Assault (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

An enhanced force draining strategy combined with a massive beat down strategy to produce a deal deck!

The published list has 59 cards.

These cards were posted as Defensive Shields outside the deck.

* 1x {{CardLink|Resistance (Dark)|Ref3-D-resistance.gif|label=Resistance}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Oppressive Enforcement (Dark)|Ref3-D-oppressiveenforcement.gif|label=Oppressive Enforcement}}
* 1x {{CardLink|There Is No Try (Dark)|Ref3-D-thereisnotry.gif|label=There Is No Try}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Allegations Of Corruption (Dark)|Ref3-D-allegationsofcorruption.gif|label=Allegations Of Corruption}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Come Here You Big Coward (Dark)|Ref3-D-comehereyoubigcoward.gif|label=Come Here You Big Coward}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (Dark)|Ref3-D-wipethemoutallofthem.gif|label=Wipe Them Out, All Of Them}}

The six Defensive Shields named in the starting section (Resistance, Oppressive Enforcement, There Is No Try, Allegations Of Corruption, Come Here You Big Coward, Wipe Them Out, All Of Them) are dested outside the 60.

== Notes ==

* Qty 59 as published: the Starting header says 9, but the starting section has only 8 cards besides the six shields. Secret Plans, listed after the objective there, is dested as the Special Edition Effect inside the deck.
* Posted 'Battle Order & Mobilization Points' (no such combo; Mobilization Points is already in the starting YCHF combo) dested Battle Order & First Strike.
* Original-era (V): Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V) and Admiral Motti (V) (Virtual Set 2); A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Set 4); We're The Bait (V) and Atmospheric Assault (V) (Virtual Set 6).
* Posted Tryant dested Tyrant; Elis Herlot dested Elis Helrot; Cloud City dested Bespin: Cloud City; Dagobah: The Cave dested Dagobah: Cave; SFS-Ls7.2 Tie Cannon dested SFS L-s7.2 TIE Cannon. Executor x2 is dested as posted.

== Strategy ==

Average destiny:  2.3

Turn One:  Pull and deploy Bespin, Cloud City: West Gallery, Cloud City: Chasm Walkway, They Must Never Again Leave This City and Executor.  If possible, pull and deploy a cave.  Draw.

Turn Two:  Pull and deploy Cloud City.  Deploy to Bespin, Cloud City and its sites; the star destroyers are used to control Bespin, the starfighters are used to control Cloud City.  I added a cannon to hit defiant starfighters.  Atmospheric Assault (V) has been added in case the situation to use it arises.  Draw if necessary.

Use the likes of Maul, Vader, Mara and Tarkin to control three Cloud City sites.  Accompany them with admirals and garrisons.

Pull and deploy Dark Deal, flip objective.  We're The Bait (V) can pull Dark Deal or They Must Never Again Leave This City.  Drain until you are forced to start using battles as a means of force loss.

Start grouping starships/characters together at one location.  Starships at Cloud City can move to Bespin to accompany the star destroyers, if safe and possible.  Use the concentration-Elis Herlot-Dark Jedi Presence and fleet-Gravity Shadow combos to cause massive beat downs.  Sense any counter to your massive beat downs, if possible.  Wait out Quite A Mercenary, etc.

After beat downs have commensed, continue Dark Deal draining.  Repeat cycle.  The act of trying to cancel Dark Deal will make opponent vulnerable to a massive beat down  by wearing thin his line of defense.  Whereas preparation against a massive beat down will result in more Dark Deal force draining, making him come to you.

Other notibles:  All Too Easy and Join Me!  : D
